What we do

Fitness for the whole person

A warm, faith-aware community where people train hard, eat well and recover properly. Respectful and welcoming — the focus is health, strength and showing up for each other.

Group Training

Outdoor sessions, real community energy

Training at Jesus and Fitness happens outdoors, together. Sessions bring the community out in the fresh air at Uwa Plaza — moving in sync, encouraging one another, and finishing stronger than they started.

Whether you are joining for cardio, strength, or both, you train as part of the group, with Coach Abraham Greatman leading from the front.

  • ✓ Outdoor group workouts at Uwa Plaza, Mgbuoba
  • ✓ Cardio sessions for stamina and energy
  • ✓ Strength training as part of the programme
  • ✓ Led by Coach Abraham Greatman (Greatman Fitness)

Strength training

Build strength with guided weight work as part of your training — progressive, coached, and done together so your form stays right and your motivation stays up.

Cardio

Cardio & group energy

Cardio at JF Fitness is a group affair — rhythmic, outdoor and full of energy. It is hard to skip a session when the whole community is expecting you.

  • ✓ Sessions led outdoors, as a group
  • ✓ Built for stamina, energy and heart health
  • ✓ Encouragement from the whole JF family

Nutrition & Wellness

Eat well. Recover well.

Training is only part of the picture. JF Fitness also supports members with nutrition therapy and massage therapy, so progress in the session is backed up at the table and in recovery.

Nutrition therapy — local meals

Nutrition therapy built around local meals: the foods you already eat, guided in a way that supports your training and your health goals. No imported diet plans — practical guidance that fits real life in Port Harcourt.

Massage therapy

Massage therapy to help your body recover between sessions — easing tired, worked muscles so you can come back ready for the next workout.

For organisations

Corporate & church training

JF Fitness trains groups beyond its regular membership — bringing the same outdoor energy and coaching to organisations across Port Harcourt.

Corporate teams

Group training and wellness sessions for companies that want a healthier, more energised team.

Churches

Faith-aware fitness sessions for church groups and congregations, in a respectful, welcoming atmosphere.

Government groups

Training for government teams and public-sector groups looking for structured group fitness.

Planning a session for your organisation? Send an enquiry and the team will discuss what your group needs.
